mil7.5.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, undurassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. - Yathā mahārāja unduro ito c' ito ca vicaranto āhārūpasiṃsako yeva carati, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ito c' ito ca vicarantena yoniso manasikārūpasiṃsaken' eva bhavitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja undurassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Upasenena Vangantaputtena:
mil7.5.3:2.1: Dhammasīsaṃ karitvāna viharanto vipassako anolīno viharati upasanto sadā sato ti.
